# Pixelette Certified — Full Page Directory

> UK-headquartered compliance consultancy. Certification readiness, cyber assurance, privacy and AI governance. Fixed-fee, scoped before work begins. Office: 66 Paul Street, London, EC2A 4NA. Contact: info@pixelettecertified.com.

Pixelette Certified is a consultancy. It is not a certification body, it does not issue certificates, reports or attestations, and it holds no accreditation of its own. This file lists every page on pixelettecertified.com; see /llms.txt for the summary version.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://pixelettecertified.com): Proposition, buyer triggers, delivery model, service pillars, and how independent assurance stays independent.
- [Our Services](https://pixelettecertified.com/services): Full catalogue across ISO certification, cybersecurity, AI governance, and privacy compliance.
- [About](https://pixelettecertified.com/about): Company story, delivery model, how engagements are staffed, and the individual practitioner credentials held within our approved delivery network.
- [Industries](https://pixelettecertified.com/industries): Sector pages for FinTech, healthcare, SaaS, manufacturing, legal, logistics, energy, education, retail, and government suppliers.
- [Pricing](https://pixelettecertified.com/pricing): Fixed-fee model, no hourly billing, 90 days post-certification support included.
- [Contact](https://pixelettecertified.com/contact): Book a free 30-minute compliance diagnostic, or send us the requirement you have been asked to meet.
- [Blog](https://pixelettecertified.com/blog): Practitioner-written guides on certification and compliance.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pixelettecertified.com/privacy-policy)
- [Cookie Policy](https://pixelettecertified.com/cookie-policy)

## Services

- [ISO/IEC 27001 Implementation & Certification Readiness](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-27001): Information Security Management System. Gap assessment, ISMS implementation, internal readiness, and coordination of the independent certification route.
- [ISO 22301 Certification](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-22301): Business Continuity Management System, disaster recovery, resilience.
- [ISO 9001 Certification](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-9001): Quality Management System.
- [ISO 14001 Certification](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-14001): Environmental Management System, ESG obligations.
- [ISO/IEC 42001 AI Governance & Certification Readiness](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-42001): AI Management System, EU AI Act aligned. Our approved delivery network includes a PECB Certified ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor.
- [Cyber Essentials Readiness & Coordination](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/cyber-essentials): Readiness and remediation support for CE and CE Plus. The formal assessment is delivered through the appropriate authorised route.
- [vCISO](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/vciso): Virtual Chief Information Security Officer on a monthly retainer.
- [vDPO](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/vdpo): Virtual Data Protection Officer, GDPR compliance, DSRs, DPIAs, ICO liaison.
- [GDPR & Privacy](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/gdpr-privacy): UK and EU GDPR compliance programmes.

## Evidence Policy

We do not publish client case studies, testimonials, certification counts, pass rates or average delivery times. Client work is confidential, and proof is published only where it can be substantiated and correctly attributed.
